C1.worst_defect: Hero line calls Vendure 'the open-source headless commerce framework', which is developer jargon to a shop owner. On the phone the hero till image shows only two product tiles and the category chips are cut off mid-word ('Gif').

C2.worst_defect: The refund row says refunds 'stay Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls; see Plugin setup'. That is honest, but it sends a non-developer owner to a developer page for a routine counter task, and it does not say plainly that each refund needs the freelance developer.
C2.where: home live-demo vs own-store table, Refund row; at-the-till Refund a sale

C3.worst_defect: Getting a till running is a nine-step developer job (npm install, migrations via tsx, bearer tokenMethod, CORS_ORIGINS, tax strategy). The owner has to hand the whole page to their developer. Connect a till then warns in the Changelog, not in the steps, that the device-key role 'has no ReadOrder, so the till's order history is refused until you add it'.

C4.worst_defect: Troubleshooting mixes cashier help with errorCode values, needs_admin GraphQL and the VENDUREPOS_WEB_ALLOW_LAN_HTTP env var on one page. Connect a till opens with localStorage, SQLite and PostHog event names before a cashier reaches 'Enter your store details'. At the till offers 'or the device's camera' for scanning while saying phones and tablets are not tested.
C4.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01; connect-a-till.desktop.01 'Where your data goes'; at-the-till 'What you need at the counter'

C5.worst_defect: The close-the-day screenshot is a large, mostly empty frame with only 'Register closed / Closure #1 / Counted €120.09 / Expected €120.09 / Exact'. The Z report the text describes is never shown.

C6.worst_defect: In the cashier-sheet screenshot, 'Register · open since 22:07' sits next to 'Last synced 10:07 PM', mixing 24-hour and 12-hour clocks in one image. A grey crop strip runs down its left edge.

C7.worst_defect: Small Lighthouse misses only: 53 KiB of unused JavaScript and 14 KiB of legacy JavaScript on /, plus 110 ms of render-blocking. LCP is 2.3-2.4 s on mobile.

overall_worst.defect: On the owner's own store, plugin 0.3.0 cannot finish a refund. The refund 'stays Pending until an administrator settles it with two Admin API calls', and those calls are documented only on the developer-facing Plugin setup page. Two staff at a counter cannot complete a routine refund without phoning the freelance developer.
overall_worst.where: home own-store table Refund row; at-the-till Refund a sale; plugin-setup 'Settle a Dashboard refund'
overall_worst.fix: Under At the till › Refund a sale, add a boxed 'Your developer must do this once per refund' note. Include the exact copy-paste settleRefund call, or a Dashboard route if one exists. Say the same in plain words on the home Refund row, so the owner knows before installing.
